answer: A lotus lattice of recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments binds each agent's history to a succinct digest, while a ripple-verifiable delay function throttles fork creation. Cloning identity would require inverting a collision-resistant hash or solving a hard lattice problem, so the entropy advantage stays below the honest bound. A haven of staked collateral and slashing penalties makes expected sybil utility negative, yielding a robust Nash equilibrium.
